description: This file defines custom Kivy UI components with focus behavior, including classes for focusable widgets that change background color when focused, and a sample application demonstrating focus navigation among labels in a grid layout.

classes.name: FocusWithColor
classes.description: A focusable widget that changes its background color when focused.

classes.name: FocusLabel
classes.description: A label that turns red when focused and sets keyboard input to its text.

classes.name: FocusGridLayout
classes.description: A grid layout with focus behavior.

classes.name: FocusBoxLayout
classes.description: A box layout with focus behavior.

classes.name: FocusApp
classes.description: Main application class demonstrating focus navigation among labels.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes FocusWithColor, sets up color and rectangle, binds size and position updates.

methods.name: _update_rect
methods.description: Updates rectangle position and size based on widget size and position.

methods.name: on_focused
methods.description: Changes background color to red when focused, resets when unfocused.

methods.name: keyboard_on_key_down
methods.description: Handles key press events, updates label text with key code.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout with focusable labels and focus navigation logic.
